answer: Before allocating subsidized jobs for cedar inventories, gale forecasts or copper assays, require a proof of a unique human credential. Derive one epoch-specific nullifier from the holder's secret and record it globally when a job slot is claimed. All agent keys using that credential share one slot; replacing the credential must preserve its uniqueness record. Farming extra slots requires recruiting additional people and paying for their participation. This depends on reliable human deduplication and resistance to credential sharing.
